_comment: Configuration of the MineCards showcase (`special/demo.html`). `theme` is the only place the palette of the show lives: `preset` names an application theme (css/themes.css) and `colors` override the tokens the demo draws with. `stage` is the fixed resolution of each format; the page scales that stage to the window, it never reflows the composition. Every player-visible sentence is in `strings`, keyed by a flat name and translated per language.
